moments.text: Black-and-white infrared view down onto flat-roofed buildings, walls and a street, purple crosshair and north marker, redaction boxes at the edges.
The picture washes out, first pale, then flat grey, until building detail almost disappears.
The screen goes dark, then flashes white for about 0.4 s. Use frame step.
A wider view of rooftops and streets returns around the crosshair.
A dark elongated streak enters past the left redaction box, crosses below the crosshair and exits right. 15 frames (~0.5 s): use frame step.
The picture dims to darker grey and holds on the same streets until the clip ends.

notes: Official description says 0:00-0:13 'No content', but the frames show buildings in IR the whole time.
